shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel
repeated small decorative units (rows of curls / rows of identical figures)
horizontal register band framing the composition
stylized rendering of hair/beard as regular patterned rows
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile imagery organised within horizontal framing bands, and both render hair or mane as tightly ordered rows of identical curls and layered locks, a moderately specific stylistic convention. However, the depicted subjects are quite different: A shows a procession of repeated standing human figures in identical file beneath architectural remains, while B shows a single large predatory bird- or dragon-headed creature's head filling the panel with a hand/arm below it.
